questions.question: Which widget provides a consolidated view of all tasks and to-dos assigned to an employee in Employee Center?

explanation.correct: The My Active Items Widget provides a consolidated view into all the tasks and to-dos assigned to the employee. It is designed to be configured and extended to additional tasks. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Quick Links Widget provides quick access to important content and pages, not task tracking.
Recommended for you widget highlights relevant content based on popularity or ML algorithms.
Favorites Page provides quick access to favorite items, not active tasks.

source.excerpt: My Active Items Widget - Provides a consolidated view into all the tasks and to-dos assigned to the employee. It is designed to be configured and extended to additional tasks.

questions.question: Which widgets are present on the Employee Center Pro home page? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: Employee Center Pro home page includes: Content Experience, Recommended for you, Popular topics, Upcoming Events, My Active Items, Videos, App launcher, and Homepage Search. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employee Taxonomy is part of Curated Experiences configuration, not a home page widget.
Workflow Designer is not an Employee Center widget; it's a platform development tool.

source.excerpt: Employee Center Pro - Validate home page widgets - Validates the following widgets are present on the Employee Center Pro home page: Content Experience, Recommended for you, Popular topics, Upcoming Events, My Active Items, Videos, App launcher, Homepage Search.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Recommended for you widget in Employee Center?

options.text: Shows tasks assigned to the employee
Highlights the most relevant content based on popularity or ML algorithm

explanation.correct: The Recommended for you widget highlights the most relevant content for the employee. It is based on popularity or ML-algorithm (if entitled for Predictive Intelligence capabilities) that looks at similarity in employee profile to show popular content. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: My Active Items Widget shows tasks assigned to the employee, not the Recommended widget.
Organization Chart widget (org_chart) displays the organizational relationships.
App Launcher widget provides access to recently-used applications.

source.excerpt: Recommended for you widget - Highlights the most relevant content for the employee. It is based on popularity or ML-algorithm (if entitled for Predictive Intelligence capabilities) that looks at similarity in employee profile to show popular content.

questions.question: What is the widget ID for the App Launcher in Employee Center Pro?

explanation.correct: The App Launcher widget has the ID 'app-launcher'. It appears on the home page to provide one-click access to recently-used applications and favorites. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: ec-app-launcher is not the correct widget ID.
web_applications is a separate widget that provides access to applications assigned to the user.
application_menu is not a valid Employee Center widget ID.

source.excerpt: App Launcher | app-launcher | Appears on the home page to provide one-click access to recently-used applications and favorites.

questions.question: Which Content Publishing widget shows portal content with content type of Banner, generally used to show informative messages?

explanation.correct: The Welcome Banner (CD) widget with ID 'cd-banner' shows portal content with content type of Banner. It is generally used to show informative banners/text and shows in a carousel when there are multiple items. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Announcements (CD) shows Rich Text content type, brief broadcast messages.
Styled Content (CD) shows Styled Content type with configurable colors and alignment.
Featured News shows highlighted articles at the top of News Center.

source.excerpt: Welcome Banner (CD) | cd-banner | Shows portal content with content type of Banner. Generally used to show informative banners/text. Shows in a carousel when there are multiple items.

questions.question: Which is NOT a valid video platform supported by the Video Carousel (CD) widget?

options.text: Both YouTube and Vimeo are supported

explanation.correct: Brightcove is NOT supported by the Video Carousel (CD) widget. Only YouTube and Vimeo embedded links are supported for displaying videos in the carousel. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: YouTube is explicitly supported by the Video Carousel widget.
Vimeo is explicitly supported by the Video Carousel widget.
Both are supported, so this option is correct but doesn't identify what is NOT supported.

source.excerpt: Video Carousel (CD) | cd-video-carousel | Shows portal content with content type of Video. Multiple videos show in a carousel. Note: Only YouTube and Vimeo embedded links are supported.

questions.question: Which quick start tests validate approval functionality in Employee Center? (Choose two.)

options.text: Employee Center - Approval Hub Approve Request
Employee Center - Approval Hub Reject Request

explanation.correct: Two tests validate approval functionality: 'Employee Center - Approval Hub Approve Request' verifies approval functionality and that approved requests appear in the Completed column. 'Employee Center - Approval Hub Reject Request' verifies rejection functionality and that rejected requests appear in the Completed column. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employee Center - My Favorites verifies favorite functionality for KB articles and catalog items.
Employee Center - Topic Page tests associating KB articles or catalog items to topics.

source.excerpt: Employee Center - Approval Hub Approve Request - Verifies the approval functionality in the Employee Center. Also verifies that when a request is approved, it appears in the user's Completed column. Employee Center - Approval Hub Reject Request - Verifies the rejection functionality. Also verifies that when a request is rejected, it appears in the user's Completed column.

questions.question: In which ServiceNow release was the 'Employee center - Employee Profile Generation' quick start test introduced?

explanation.correct: The 'Employee center - Employee Profile Generation' test that verifies employee profiles are generated as per the employee definition was introduced in the Xanadu release. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: San Diego introduced many EC tests but not the Employee Profile Generation test.
Tokyo is not listed as the release version for this test.
Utah is not listed as the release version for this test.

source.excerpt: Employee center - Employee Profile Generation | Verifies that employee profiles are generated as per the employee definition. | Xanadu

questions.question: Which plugins must be activated to run Employee Center and Employee Center Pro quick start tests?

explanation.correct: To run Employee Center quick start tests, the Agile Development 2.0 (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0) and Agile Development 2.0 - ATF Tests (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0.atf) plugins must be enabled. Demo data is also required. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: com.sn_hr_core is needed for HR functionality but not specifically for ATF tests.
These are required for the features being tested, not for running the ATF tests themselves.
This is needed for Employee Center Pro features, not for running the tests.

source.excerpt: The Agile Development 2.0 (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0) and the Agile Development 2.0 - ATF Tests (com.snc.sdlc.agile.2.0.atf) plugins must be enabled. Note: When running, demo data is required.

questions.question: Where can administrators navigate to view the full list of Employee Center widgets?

explanation.correct: To see the full list of Employee Center widgets, you can navigate to All > Service Portal > Widgets. This section provides a quick overview of all available widgets that can be used or cloned. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employee Center module doesn't have a direct Widgets sub-module.
HR Administration contains HR-specific configuration, not the widget library.
System UI doesn't contain Service Portal widgets.

source.excerpt: To see the full list of widgets, you can navigate to All > Service Portal > Widgets.

questions.question: Which widget displays the relationships between employees in an organization chart format in Employee Center Pro?

explanation.correct: The Organization Chart (EC) widget with ID 'org_chart' displays the employees organization chart, the relationships to other employees, and more. This is the Employee Center Pro specific widget for org charts. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employee Profile My Team displays team information but not the full organization chart visualization.
cd-orgchart is a Content Delivery widget, not the primary EC Pro org chart widget.
Employee Profile Overview displays profile overview information, not organizational relationships.

source.excerpt: Organization Chart (EC) | org_chart | Displays the employees organization chart, the relationships to other employees, and more.

questions.question: An administrator wants to test that a user can submit an HR catalog item that creates both a Universal Request and an HR case with linking between them. Which quick start test validates this functionality?

options.text: ESC: Post General HR Inquiry questions on ESC portal
ESC: Submit a Record Producer which creates Universal Request and HR Case
ESC: Verify Standard Ticket page on ESC for HR Case
HR: Search catalog items & KBs in ESC

explanation.correct: The 'ESC: Submit a Record Producer which creates Universal Request and HR Case' test verifies a user can submit an HR catalog item that creates a Universal Request. It also verifies the Universal Request and HR case are created and linked. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This test verifies creating a General Inquiry case and posting questions, not Universal Request linking.
This test verifies the Standard Ticket page appearance for an HR case.
This test verifies search functionality in the Employee Service Center.

source.excerpt: ESC: Submit a Record Producer which creates Universal Request and HR Case - Verifies a user can submit an HR catalog item that creates a Universal Request. Also verifies the Universal Request and HR case are created and linked.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Content Analytics Site Tracker widget?

options.text: Analyze user behavior, usage metrics, and more from the user experience dashboard

explanation.correct: The Content Analytics Site Tracker widget (ID: cda-site-analytics) helps analyze user behavior, usage metrics, and more from the user experience dashboard. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The widget tracks user behavior on the portal, not physical location data.
HR case metrics are tracked through Performance Analytics, not this widget.
Training completions are tracked in Learning Management, not this analytics widget.

source.excerpt: Content Analytics Site Tracker | cda-site-analytics | Helps analyze user behavior, usage metrics, and more from the user experience dashboard.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is true about quick start tests in Employee Center?
a) Quick start tests are enabled by default and can be run immediately
b) All test suites pass on a default implementation with demo data
c) Quick start tests cannot be copied or customized
d) Quick start tests do not support performance profiling

options.text: Both a and c are true
Both b and d are true

explanation.correct: Statement b is true: All test suites and tests should pass on a default implementation with demo data. Statement a is false because quick start tests are disabled and read-only test templates. Statement c is false because tests can be copied and configured for customizations. Statement d is false because Performance Profiling can be used to compare tests. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Quick start tests are disabled by default, not enabled.
Both statements are false - tests are disabled and can be copied.
Statement d is false - Performance Profiling is supported for test comparison.

source.excerpt: All test suites and tests should pass on a default implementation. Quick start tests are disabled and read-only test templates. To make quick start tests produce a pass result when you run them with your instance-specific data, copy and configure them to use your instance data. Use Performance Profiling to compare tests to detect performance degradation.

questions.question: Which widgets are part of the Employee Profile widget set? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: The Employee Profile widget set includes: Employee Profile Details (displays basic profile and work-related information), Employee Profile Header (appears across the employee profile page), Employee Profile My Team, Employee Profile Overview, and Public Profile Visibility. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employee Taxonomy is part of Curated Experiences, not Employee Profile.
Quick Links Widget is a general Employee Center widget, not part of the Profile set.

source.excerpt: Employee Profile Details | employee_profile_details | Displays the basic profile and work-related information of an employee. Employee Profile Header | employee_profile_header | Appears across the employee profile page.

questions.question: What does the Content Experience widget (cd-content-experience) enable administrators to do?

options.text: Deliver targeted, actionable communications to employees

explanation.correct: The Content Experience widget (cd-content-experience) delivers targeted, actionable communications to employees. For more information, see Creating campaigns with Content Experiences. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Training courses are created in Learning Management, not through Content Experience widget.
Performance reports use Performance Analytics, not the Content Experience widget.
Self-service workflows are configured through Flow Designer or Workflow, not this widget.

source.excerpt: Content Experience | cd-content-experience | Delivers targeted, actionable communications to employees. For more information, see Creating campaigns with Content Experiences.

questions.question: Which Content Governance quick start test provides end-to-end testing from content request creation through publishing?

options.text: Content Governance - New Content Request E2E Workflow
Content Experiences: Create and Publish a Campaign

explanation.correct: The 'Content Governance - New Content Request E2E Workflow' test provides end-to-end testing from creating a content request through publishing the content. This is the comprehensive test for the content governance workflow. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/quick-start-tests-employee-center.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: This test validates audience configurations for Content Publishing only.
This test creates and schedules test content, not the full governance workflow.
This test focuses on campaigns in Content Experiences, not governance workflow.

source.excerpt: Content Governance - New Content Request E2E Workflow - Provides end-to-end testing from creating a content request through publishing the content.

questions.question: An organization wants to use base system widgets as-is in their Employee Center without modification. Which approach is recommended?

options.text: Always clone widgets before using them
Use base system widgets directly, then clone only if customization is needed
Create all widgets from scratch to avoid upgrade conflicts
Use only third-party widgets from the ServiceNow Store

explanation.correct: You can use base system widgets as-is in your Employee Center or clone them to suit your own business needs. The documentation recommends using them directly and cloning only when customization is required. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Cloning is only recommended when customization is needed, not for all widgets.
Creating from scratch is unnecessary and loses the benefit of pre-built, tested widgets.
Base system widgets are designed for Employee Center and should be used where applicable.

source.excerpt: You can use base system widgets as-is in your Employee Center or clone them to suit your own business needs.

questions.question: Which Employee Center Pro Kiosk widget enables login and access to the kiosk portal?

options.text: Employee Center Pro Kiosk Portal login

explanation.correct: The Employee Center Pro Kiosk Portal login widget (ec-pro-kiosk-portal-login) enables the login and access to the kiosk portal. This is the authentication widget for the Kiosk experience. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/employee-center-widgets-list.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Kiosk Header appears across the portal and provides quick access to features, but doesn't handle login.
Preferences widget shows user preferences like accessibility and language, not login functionality.
Employee Upcoming Shift shows upcoming events, not login functionality.

source.excerpt: Employee Center Pro Kiosk Portal login | ec-pro-kiosk-portal-login | Enables the login and access to the kiosk portal.

questions.question: What role is required to create a task for a case in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management?

explanation.correct: The sn_hr_core.case_writer role is required to create a task for a case in Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_hr_core.admin is for HR administration, not specifically task creation
sn_hr_core.task_writer is not a valid ServiceNow role
sn_hr_ef.document_writer is for document management, not task creation

source.excerpt: Role required: sn_hr_core.case_writer

questions.question: Which HR task type should be used to collect information from employees using a questionnaire built in the survey designer?

explanation.correct: The 'Collect Employee Input' task type collects information from employees. It uses employee forms, which are questionnaires built using the survey designer to collect information from employees.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Take Survey is for assigning surveys, not collecting employee input via forms
Submit Catalog Item fulfills tasks via catalog items, not employee forms
Upload Documents requests document uploads, not form-based information collection

source.excerpt: Collect Employee Input: Collects information from employees. In the Employee form field, select the employee form that the user fills out or verifies. Note: Employee forms are questionnaires built using the survey designer to collect information from employees.

questions.question: Which HR task types can be used to request user acknowledgment of a document? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: Both 'Credential' and 'E-signature' task types require users to acknowledge documents. Credential requires login acknowledgment while E-signature requires electronic signature of the document.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Checklist provides instructions or steps but does not require document acknowledgment
View Video requests video viewing, not document acknowledgment

source.excerpt: Credential: Indicates that you want the user to acknowledge reading a document by logging in with their login credentials. E-signature: User electronically signs a document.

questions.question: An HR agent needs to schedule an onboarding meeting with a new hire and send the invite to their Microsoft Outlook. Which task type should be used?

explanation.correct: The 'Schedule a meeting' task type enables creating meeting invites for employees while working on an HR case. It integrates with Microsoft Outlook to send meeting invites and requires the ServiceNow Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke.

wrongAnswers.explanation: URL task type links to a URL for acknowledgment, not meeting scheduling
Checklist provides instructions but does not schedule meetings
HR Service fulfills tasks via HR services, not meeting scheduling

source.excerpt: Schedule a meeting: Enables you to create a meeting invite for an employee while you are working on an HR case. For example, you can schedule a meeting with a new hire as part of the onboarding process. You can view the available slots of an employee and schedule a meeting. The employee will receive a meeting invite on Microsoft Outlook.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Mark When Complete' task type?

options.text: To automatically mark the case as complete
To show a Completed button on HR Service Portal that changes task state to Closed Complete
To send a notification when the task is completed

explanation.correct: The 'Mark When Complete' task type notifies the user that a Completed button appears on the HR Service Portal. When clicked, it changes the state of the task to Closed Complete.

wrongAnswers.explanation: It marks the task complete, not the entire case
While notifications may be sent, the primary purpose is the Completed button functionality
Generating reports is not the purpose of this task type

source.excerpt: Mark When Complete: Notify the user a Completed button appears on the HR Service Portal. Use the Short description to provide details about this task. Note: Mark When Complete changes the state of the task to Closed Complete.

questions.question: Which spoke must be installed for the meeting invite and scheduling capability in HR tasks?

explanation.correct: For the meeting invite and scheduling capability in HR tasks, the ServiceNow Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke must be installed.

wrongAnswers.explanation: ServiceNow Calendar Spoke is not the required spoke for this functionality
ServiceNow Meeting Manager Spoke is not a valid spoke name
Google Calendar Spoke is not required for Microsoft Outlook integration

source.excerpt: Note: For the meeting invite and scheduling capability, you must install the ServiceNow Microsoft Exchange Online Spoke.

questions.question: In which state must an HR task be for the 'Upload Documents' task type to work?

explanation.correct: For the 'Upload Documents' task type, the task must be in 'Ready' or 'Work in Progress' state for users to upload documents.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Draft and Pending are not the required states for document upload
Open and Active are not valid task states for this requirement
The specific required states are Ready or Work in Progress, not all non-closed states

source.excerpt: Upload Documents: Requests the person assigned to the task to upload documents. Examples are receipts, course registration, or transcripts for tuition reimbursement. Note: The task must be in Ready or Work in Progress.

questions.question: Where do you navigate to access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management to create tasks?

options.text: All > HR Case Management > Agent Workspace for HR Case Management

explanation.correct: The navigation path to access Agent Workspace for HR Case Management is All > HR Case Management > Agent Workspace for HR Case Management.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This navigation path does not exist for HR Case Management
This navigation path is incorrect
This navigation path is incorrect

source.excerpt: Navigate to All > HR Case Management > Agent Workspace for HR Case Management and select a case you want to add a task to.

questions.question: Which Employee Center widget is designed specifically for new hires and only appears before their start date?

explanation.correct: The Start Date widget only appears to new hires prior to their start date for onboarding cases only. When using the base system layout, it should be placed on the Employee Center home page in the right-hand pane above the My Items widget. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/hr-service-delivery/employee-center-hr.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The My Items widget shows general items/tasks for all employees, not specific to new hires.
The Parental Leave Guide widget provides a link to parental leave resources, not related to onboarding start dates.
The Organization Chart widget displays employee relationships and is available to all employees.

source.excerpt: Start Date widget: This widget only appears to new hires prior to their start date for onboarding cases only.

questions.question: Which widget in Employee Center Pro provides one-click access to recently used applications and favorites?

explanation.correct: The App Launcher widget appears on the Employee Center Pro home page and provides one-click access to recently used applications and favorites. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/employee-experience-foundation/components-installed-with-employee-center-pro.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Web Applications widget provides access to assigned applications, but the App Launcher specifically focuses on recently-used apps and favorites.
The Experience Feedback widget drives the feedback workflow and survey functionality, not application access.
The Organization Chart widget displays employee relationships, not application access.

source.excerpt: App Launcher: Appears on the home page to provide one-click access to recently-used applications and favorites.

questions.question: An HR administrator wants lifecycle event activity sets to be visible to the subject person (employee) in the Employee Center. What two configurations are required?

options.text: Select "Display activity sets to subject person" on the lifecycle event AND select "Show case to subject person" on the HR service
Grant the employee the sn_hr_le.admin role AND enable the Employee Center Pro plugin
Create a topic mapping AND enable the HR taxonomy plugin
Add the employee to the owning group AND set the activity type to Employee task

explanation.correct: Displaying activity sets to the subject person is a two-part process: select "Display activity sets to subject person" on the lifecycle event form, AND select "Show case to subject person" for the HR service associated with the lifecycle event. If the second is not selected, the activity sets timeline will not display. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-type.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Employees do not need the admin role to view activity sets; the configuration is on the lifecycle event and HR service records.
Topic mappings and taxonomy are for search and content organization, not for displaying activity set timelines.
Owning groups control activity management, not the visibility of activity set timelines to subject persons.

source.excerpt: Display activity sets to subject person: This is a two-part process. In addition to selecting the box here, you must also select Show case to subject person for the HR service.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the "Display title" field on a lifecycle event activity set?

options.text: It replaces the activity set name in administrative views
It provides an employee-facing title that appears on the activity sets timeline in portal and mobile
It defines the activity set category in the lifecycle event builder
It sets the name used in notification emails to fulfillers

explanation.correct: The Display title is employee-facing only and appears on the activity sets timeline on the HR ticket page in both portal and mobile. For example, a display title for a preboarding activity set could be "Get ready for day one." If no display title is provided, the default activity set name is used. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/xanadu/employee-service-management/lifecycle-events/configure-hr-lifecycle-event-activity-set.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Display title does not replace the admin-facing activity set name; it provides a separate employee-facing label.
The Display title does not define categories; it provides a friendly name for employees.
The Display title is for portal/mobile display, not for notification emails.

source.excerpt: Display title: The display title is employee-facing only, and appears on the activity sets timeline on the HR ticket page in both portal and mobile.
